workload: Original full frozen GPT-2 workload and original locked 0.11 per-target reference vector; no model, input, cotangent, or layout changes.

predicate.source: Unchanged frozen faultline.bisect from 0.11, as used in 0.12/0.13
predicate.score: Median log2 compiled RMSE growth against the locked stable fp64-error vector, over the same 147 positive finite gradient targets. All three workers must agree; missing targets or mixed results are inconclusive.
predicate.disappears: The intervention is not_shifted in all three fresh workers under the unchanged 1.4x threshold. Also report absolute errors, the score, and whether it returns exactly to the parent evidence. Do not call below-threshold growth exact recovery.

intervention_gate: Only replace exp_u20 in generated C++ kernels if the complete saved forward/backward code and its linked call paths establish that those kernels reach it. Distinguish native flash-attention calls from generated GELU kernels. If generated GELU uses SLEEF tanh without exp_u20, record the replacement as not applicable; do not enable a different tanh formula and call that an exp_u20 replacement.

capture.control: Warm compiled forward and backward before observation. Capture actual MLP expansion addmm outputs and eager tanh operands; require exact equality of all 149 output/gradient control tensors in both replays. Preserve tensor storage/layouts and retain raw captures locally.
capture.compiled_tanh_argument: Report the mathematical GELU tanh argument sqrt(2/pi)*(x+0.044715*x^3), evaluated in fp64 from the captured fp32 inputs, explicitly labeled reconstructed. It is not a claim of direct capture of a fused C++ intermediate. Eager actual tanh operands are recorded separately.

histograms.semantics: Half-open bins include the lower edge; separate tails below the first edge and at/above the last edge. Report all blocks, counts, extrema and absolute p95/p99.
histograms.exp_comparison: Reuse the 0.13 adapters and its fixed grids. Verify the regenerated sampled accuracy equals 0.13 before deriving per-bin parent/child exp_u20 disagreement. For every identical captured input, reconstructed tanh argument, and hypothetical decomposed-tanh exponent -2*argument (rounded to fp32), additionally compare both adapters directly. These are counterfactual exp evaluations, not actual GELU call-path exposure. Report nonfinite results separately.
histograms.block12_unusual: Predeclare two descriptive criteria, separately per build/path: block 12 absolute p99 input or tanh argument exceeds twice the median of blocks 1-11; or its counterfactual exp_u20 disagreement fraction exceeds the pooled blocks 1-11 fraction by at least 0.10. Report every block and ranks, including ties. No population-level or causal inference.

bounded_scope: No PyTorch rebuild, no new model families or broad compiler bisection. Preserve prior evidence. A standalone GELU reproducer is promoted only if the conditional full-model intervention isolates this path and the standalone case independently reproduces the accuracy shift; otherwise retain the full-model report lead.
